description:
The documentation policy was widened temporarily for archival. It ends with only the post-overhaul managed and permanent paths, and the mechanical documentation check covers the final permanent surface.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Managed paths, permanent paths and issue-scoped areas in `.jit/config.toml` name only existing directories that hold active or permanent material; temporary entries and the `dev/plans`, `dev/presentations` and `dev/sessions` entries are gone.
- [hard] REQ-02: The mechanical documentation check's configured footprint covers the root README, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/`, crate READMEs, `dev/active/` Markdown and repository-relative links in Rustdoc, and excludes `dev/archive/`.
- [hard] REQ-03: Repository validation, documentation review and the mechanical documentation check pass on the final policy.
title: Narrow the docs policy to post-overhaul paths
